def find_sequence(N, B):
    # Initialize the sequence with A1 = 0
    A = [0] * N
    # Calculate the rest of the sequence based on the matrix B
    for i in range(1, N):
        for j in range(i):
            A[i] = B[i][j] - A[j]
            A[j] = -A[i]
    return A

def update_matrix(B, p, F):
    # Update the matrix B at row p and column p with the new values F
    for i in range(len(B)):
        B[i][p] = B[p][i] = abs(F[i] - F[p])
    return B

def main():
    # Read the initial matrix B
    N, Q = map(int, input().split())
    B = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]
    
    # Find the initial sequence A
    A = find_sequence(N, B)
    print(*A)
    
    # Process each query
    for _ in range(Q):
        p = int(input()) - 1  # Convert to 0-based index
        F = list(map(int, input().split()))
        
        # Update the matrix B with the new values
        B = update_matrix(B, p, F)
        
        # Find the new sequence A
        A = find_sequence(N, B)
        print(*A)

# Run the main function
main()
